:::{#thm-flat-point-critical}
#### Every flat point is a critical point

If $c$ is a flat point of $f$ (@def-flat-point), then $c$ is a critical point of $f$ (@def-critical-point).

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

A flat point $c$ has $f$ differentiable at $c$ and $f'(c) = 0$.
The condition "$f'(c) = 0$" is the first alternative in @def-critical-point,
so $c$ is a critical point.

:::
